isFree.question: Is LocalPDFKit really free?
isFree.answer: Yes, absolutely. All tools on LocalPDFKit are free to use, with no sign-ups and no watermarks for core browser-based tasks. We believe everyone deserves access to simple, powerful PDF tools without a paywall.

areFilesSecure.question: Are my files secure? Where are they processed?
areFilesSecure.answer: Core tools are designed to process files directly in your browser, so documents do not need to be uploaded to our servers for common PDF tasks.

platforms.question: Does it work on Mac, Windows, and Mobile?
platforms.answer: Yes! Since LocalPDFKit runs entirely in your browser, it works on any operating system with a modern web browser, including Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

gdprCompliant.question: Is LocalPDFKit GDPR compliant?
gdprCompliant.answer: LocalPDFKit is designed around browser-based processing and clear policy pages. Compliance can depend on location, tool choice, browser setup, and optional integrations, so users should review the active Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy.

dataStorage.question: Do you store or track any of my files?
dataStorage.answer: Core file operations are designed to happen in your browser session. LocalPDFKit does not intentionally store document contents from browser-based tools on an application server.

different.question: What makes LocalPDFKit different from other PDF tools?
different.answer: Many online PDF services rely on server-side processing. LocalPDFKit focuses on browser-based tools for common workflows, with clear support pages that explain privacy, cookies, ads, and practical limits.

browserBased.question: How does browser-based processing keep me safe?
browserBased.answer: Browser-based processing reduces unnecessary file transfers for common PDF tasks. Users should still review outputs, browser settings, optional integrations, and policy pages before relying on a workflow.

analytics.question: Do you use cookies or analytics to track me?
analytics.answer: LocalPDFKit may use privacy-focused measurement tools and may add advertising or consent tools later. Material changes should be reflected in the Cookie Policy and Privacy Policy.

hero.subtitle: fast, private, and free.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To provide the most comprehensive PDF toolbox that respects your privacy and never asks for payment. We believe essential document tools should be accessible to everyone, everywhere, without barriers.

philosophy.label: Our Core Philosophy
philosophy.title: Privacy First. Always.
philosophy.description: In an era where data is a commodity, we take a different approach. All processing for LocalPDFKit tools happens locally in your browser. This means your files never touch our servers, we never see your documents, and we don't track what you do. Your documents remain completely and unequivocally private. It's not just a feature; it's our foundation.

speed.title: Built for Speed
speed.description: No waiting for uploads or downloads to a server. By processing files directly in your browser using modern web technologies like WebAssembly, we offer unparalleled speed for all our tools.

free.title: Completely Free
free.description: No trials, no subscriptions, no hidden fees, and no "premium" features held hostage. We believe powerful PDF tools should be a public utility, not a profit center.

noAccount.title: No Account Required
noAccount.description: Start using any tool immediately. We don't need your email, a password, or any personal information. Your workflow should be frictionless and anonymous.

openSource.title: Open Source Spirit
openSource.description: Built with transparency in mind. We leverage incredible open-source libraries like PDF-lib and PDF.js, and believe in the community-driven effort to make powerful tools accessible to everyone.
